title: Betelgeuse Fell To 36% Brightness—Then Recovered
hook: Betelgeuse dropped to 36% of normal brightness.
closing: A dramatic dimming can be dust, not a countdown to explosion.
question: Would that dimming have fooled you?

segments.say: Betelgeuse fell to 36% of normal brightness. The sudden fade looked far more final than it was.
Dust obscured 50% of Betelgeuse's imaged disk. The star was partly hidden, not gone.
The estimated supernova remains 100,000 years away. A brief dimming was not the finale.
